newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swissair shares firm on H1 result.
newsitem.headline: Swissair shares firm on H1 result.

text.p: Shares in Swissair AG rose on news that the Swiss carrier had narrowed its loss in the first half and expected to report a profit for the full year.
"The size of the loss was a positive surprise, we had expected a higher loss. But the forecast is also good," a Swiss dealer said.
At 0845 GMT Swissair's share were up seven francs, or 0.6 percent to 1,097 francs in a generally weaker market.
Turnover in Swissair's shares was low with around 1,000 shares traded, but overall trading on the Swiss Exchange was also low, dealers added.
The result was in line with analysts' forecast on average, but estimates ranged from a loss of 70 million to a loss of 30 million.
